metrics.name: order_count
metrics.description: Count physical orders in the requested IST periods. Plain order_count uses placed-order population and does not exclude later-cancelled orders unless an explicit qualifying/non-cancelled filter is requested.

metrics.name: cancelled_order_count
metrics.description: Count orders whose native order.status is canceled/cancelled OR whose non-null order.zoho_order_status is CANCELED/CANCELLED.

metrics.name: cancellation_rate
metrics.description: Cancelled order count divided by all placed orders in the same requested bucket, expressed as a percentage.
